
FUNCTION 'Copia de_Main' GLOBAL
    Folder.GetFiles Folder: $'''C:\\Users\\Usuario\\Documents\\Proyecto personal\\power-automate\\robot-facturas\\Facturas\\Entrada''' FileFilter: $'''*.pdf''' IncludeSubfolders: False FailOnAccessDenied: True SortBy1: Folder.SortBy.Name SortDescending1: False SortBy2: Folder.SortBy.NoSort SortDescending2: False SortBy3: Folder.SortBy.NoSort SortDescending3: False Files=> Files
    Excel.LaunchExcel.LaunchAndOpenUnderExistingProcess Path: $'''C:\\Users\\Usuario\\Documents\\Proyecto personal\\power-automate\\robot-facturas\\Control_Facturas.xlsx''' Visible: True ReadOnly: False UseMachineLocale: False Instance=> ExcelInstance
    SET Fila TO 2
    SET CantOk TO 0
    SET CantError TO 0
    WebAutomation.LaunchChrome.LaunchChrome Url: $'''file:///C:/Users/Usuario/Documents/Proyecto personal/power-automate/robot-facturas/SistemaProveedores/index.html''' WindowState: WebAutomation.BrowserWindowState.Maximized ClearCache: False ClearCookies: False WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 Timeout: 60 PiPUserDataFolderMode: WebAutomation.PiPUserDataFolderModeEnum.AutomaticProfile TargetDesktop: $'''{\"DisplayName\":\"Equipo local\",\"Route\":{\"ServerType\":\"Local\",\"ServerAddress\":\"\"},\"DesktopType\":\"local\"}''' BrowserInstance=> Browser
    WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextFieldUsePhysicalKeyboard BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'f ... index.html\'']['Input text \'txtUsuario\''] Text: $'''robot''' Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
    WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextFieldUsePhysicalKeyboard BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'f ... index.html\'']['Input password \'txtClave\''] Text: P'' Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
    WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'f ... index.html\'']['Button \'Ingresar\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
    LOOP FOREACH CurrentItem IN Files
        Pdf.ExtractTextFromPDF.ExtractText PDFFile: CurrentItem DetectLayout: False ExtractedText=> ExtractedPDFText
        Text.ParseText.RegexParseForFirstOccurrence Text: ExtractedPDFText TextToFind: $'''(?<=CUIT: )\\S+''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: True OccurrencePosition=> Position Match=> Cuit
        Text.ParseText.RegexParseForFirstOccurrence Text: ExtractedPDFText TextToFind: $'''(?<=Razon Social: ).+''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: True OccurrencePosition=> Position Match=> RazonSocial
        Text.ParseText.RegexParseForFirstOccurrence Text: ExtractedPDFText TextToFind: $'''(?<=Numero: )\\S+''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: True OccurrencePosition=> Position Match=> Numero
        Text.ParseText.RegexParseForFirstOccurrence Text: ExtractedPDFText TextToFind: $'''(?<=Fecha: )\\S+''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: True OccurrencePosition=> Position Match=> Fecha
        Text.ParseText.RegexParseForFirstOccurrence Text: ExtractedPDFText TextToFind: $'''(?<=Total: )\\S+''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: True OccurrencePosition=> Position Match=> Total
        IF IsEmpty(Cuit) THEN
            SET Estado TO $'''ERROR: falta CUIT'''
        ELSE
            WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextFieldUsePhysicalKeyboard BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'f ... index.html\'']['Input text \'txtCuit\' 2'] Text: Cuit Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
            WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextFieldUsePhysicalKeyboard BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'f ... index.html\'']['Input text \'txtRazonSocial\''] Text: RazonSocial Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
            WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextFieldUsePhysicalKeyboard BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'f ... index.html\'']['Input text \'txtNumero\''] Text: Numero Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
            WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextFieldUsePhysicalKeyboard BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'f ... index.html\'']['Input text \'txtFecha\''] Text: Fecha Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
            WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextFieldUsePhysicalKeyboard BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'f ... index.html\'']['Input text \'txtTotal\''] Text: Total Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
            WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'f ... index.html\'']['Button \'Guardar\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
            WAIT 1
            WebAutomation.GetDetailsOfElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'f ... index.html\'']['Div \'Error: CUIT inválido.\''] AttributeName: $'''Own Text''' AttributeValue=> MsgError
            IF IsNotEmpty(MsgError) THEN
                SET Estado TO MsgError
            ELSE
                SET Estado TO $'''OK'''
            END
        END
        DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> CurrentDateTime
        Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: {[CurrentItem.Name, RazonSocial, Cuit, Numero, Fecha, Total, Estado, CurrentDateTime] } Column: $'''A''' Row: Fila
        WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'f ... index.html\'']['Button \'Limpiar\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
        Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: Fila IncrementValue: 1
        IF Estado = $'''OK''' THEN
            File.Move Files: CurrentItem Destination: $'''C:\\Users\\Usuario\\Documents\\Proyecto personal\\power-automate\\robot-facturas\\Facturas\\Procesadas''' IfFileExists: File.IfExists.Overwrite MovedFiles=> MovedFiles
            Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: CantOk IncrementValue: 1
        ELSE
            File.Move Files: CurrentItem Destination: $'''C:\\Users\\Usuario\\Documents\\Proyecto personal\\power-automate\\robot-facturas\\Facturas\\Con error''' IfFileExists: File.IfExists.Overwrite MovedFiles=> MovedFiles
            Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: CantError IncrementValue: 1
        END
    END
    Excel.CloseExcel.CloseAndSave Instance: ExcelInstance
    WebAutomation.CloseWebBrowser BrowserInstance: Browser
    Email.SendEmail.AuthenticateAndSend SMTPServer: $'''smtp.gmail.com''' Port: 587 EnableSSL: True Username: $'''TU_GMAIL@gmail.com''' Password: P'TU_CONTRASEÑA_DE_APLICACION' AcceptUntrustedCertificates: True SendFrom: $'''TU_GMAIL@gmail.com''' SenderDisplayName: $'''ROBOT''' SendTo: $'''DESTINATARIO@mail.com''' Subject: $'''Robot Facturas - Resumen del proceso''' Body: $'''  Proceso finalizado.
  Facturas procesadas OK: %CantOk%
  Facturas con error: %CantError%
  Se adjunta el control.''' IsBodyHtml: False Attachments: $'''C:\\Users\\Usuario\\Documents\\Proyecto personal\\power-automate\\robot-facturas\\Control_Facturas.xlsx'''
END FUNCTION
